origin: hand-written from the published schema; every value invented
notes: truncated=true. This is the fixture that must never be published as a complete partition: an incomplete stream cannot replace a published one, and the truncated rows are a partial view whose total is unknown rather than a small total. Because the surface has no cursor, the only honest recovery is a narrower query (fewer dimensions, a shorter time_range, or an explicit group_limit) - not a continuation. Note also that row_count here equals the number of rows returned, so it cannot be used to detect how much was dropped.
